title: Kunti Putra
desc: Surya, an aid to the don, is feared by all the townspeople due to his association. He is assigned a job to kidnap the daughter of a wealthy businessman. However, he begins to fall in love with her.

title: Bhupathi
desc: After Bhupathi's mother and niece are attacked by the thugs of his lover's father, he decides to take revenge and turn his back on his lady.

title: Rekhachithram
desc: A disgraced cop returns to active duty and attempts to regain his honour by investigating a murder that happened 40 years ago.

title: Ek Love Ya
desc: After getting rejected by a girl, Amar, a law student, becomes resentful. Years into the future, he is arrested for a crime that eventually leads him to her.

title: Dana Kayonu
desc: A cowherd loves Jummi, the village beauty, as well as his loyal bull. However, his life changes when a multinational company offers him a huge fortune in exchange for his animal.

title: Thayige Thakka Maga
desc: Parvathi, a lawyer, and her son, Mohandas, lead a righteous life. However, they find themselves in danger after crossing paths with the son of a corrupt politician.
